data.long_meaning: Ankush is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ankuśa', which means 'hook' or 'anchor'. It is a name of Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted holding a conch shell called 'Shankha', which is also known as 'Ankush' or 'Ankusha'. The name represents power, protection, and stability. The name Ankush carries the meaning “Hook, Anchor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ankush usually hope their child will grow to embody hook, anchor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
